title: Availability
description: Two schemas in one contract. The root schema is the declaration of what a component does in each availability state (adapter returns, response block, UI, test). $defs/runtime_block is the block an API response or artifact carries when a source is not fully available. A document is validated as a declaration when it has 'components' and as a runtime block when it has 'state'.

state.description: available, partial, stale, synthetic, training or missing (case-sensitive).

adapter_returns.description: What the adapter or provider returns in this state.

response_block.description: The runtime block the API response or artifact carries in this state.

ui_shows.description: What the page shows in this state.

test.description: The id of the test that proves this state.

reason.description: A reason: a string, or an object with an 'en' string (bilingual products add 'es'); null only when available.

source.description: The provider: real, cached snapshot, synthetic fixture, model version or baseline.

age.description: An ISO 8601 duration, or null (allowed only for available and missing).
